question: What is the meaning of ease of non-destructive disassembly in relation to design for recycling?
description: Ease of non-destructive disassembly in relation to design for recycling refers to the ability to dismantle a product or building without causing damage, allowing for the recovery and reuse of materials. This approach supports the circular economy by enabling the transformation and adaptation of products or buildings, reducing waste and promoting sustainability.
